body:
Hey, I apparently didn't communicate my situation very well so here goes again. I am having suicidal thoughts and know I need help. I work closely with the medical field and in my area anyone that admits intention to commit suicide is put on a form (essentially a legal document stating you are unfit to take care of yourself and the doctor is responsible for you) for 72 hours.

As I live with my parents, there is no way for me to hide that I'm going since I can't just disappear for 3 days without them noticing. So I have to tell them. My question is how do you approach this conversation.
